relay.config.title: Relay Menu
relay.config.share_health.desc: If relay should share your health to trusted players
relay.config.hud_durability.desc: How each armor piece's remaining durability is shown on the HUD
relay.config.hud_show_health.desc: Show each teammate's health on the HUD, if their client reports it
relay.config.player_markers_enabled.desc: Show teammates' in-world location markers. Turns off both relay's markers and Xaero's.
relay.config.player_marker_size.desc: Size of relay's in-world player markers, in pixels. The name shown while hovering scales with it.
relay.config.player_marker_opacity.desc: How visible a marker is when you are not looking at it. Looking at one always shows it fully.
relay.config.player_marker_hide.desc: Markers disappear for teammates closer than this, where you can already see the player. 0 always shows them.
relay.config.player_marker_show_distance: Show how far away a teammate is, in blocks, beside their marker while you are looking at it.
relay.config.player_marker_size.xaero: Xaero is drawing the markers, so this only applies to relay's own. Turn off Xaero Markers in Integrations to use it.
relay.config.hud_shorten_coords.desc: Abbreviate large coordinates on the HUD: 3723, 50, 4282 becomes 3.7k, 50, 4.3k.
relay.config.ping_sound.desc: Play a sound when a teammate places a ping
relay.config.chat_enabled.desc: Whether relay chat can be sent or received from your client
relay.config.chat_prefix.desc: Type this character at the start of a message to send it to your mutually trusted players instead of the server
relay.config.xaero_markers.desc: Override the player location markers with xaero's rendering system instead of using relay's rendering system
relay.config.share_location.desc: If relay should share your location to trusted players
relay.config.share_armor.desc: If relay should share your armor durability to trusted players
relay.config.hud_grow_up.desc: Invert the direction hud list should go from the first element
relay.config.cross_server_pings.desc: If alerts should be sent to people on other servers
relay.config.alert_cooldown.desc: Per player cooldown until you can be alerted again
relay.config.ping_cooldown.desc: Per player cooldown until you can receive pings again
relay.config.ping_color.desc:
What ping color you should appear as to yourself and others

Your 5 ping options are based off and linked to your account
relay.config.relay_url.desc: Routing server ip, do not touch if you do not know what this does
relay.available.checking: Checking who would receive your alert...
relay.available.none: Nobody would see your alert right now
relay.available.timeout: The relay didn't answer — it may be running an older version
relay.in_world_icons.using_builtin: In-world icons: using the mod's own
relay.in_world_icons.xaero_missing: In-world icons: Xaero's Minimap isn't installed, using the mod's own
relay.banned.title: Relay Service
relay.banned.detail: You are banned from this relay
relay.config.section.sharing.desc: What relay shares about you with your trusted players.
relay.config.section.hud_colors.desc: Hex colors for the HUD text, as #rrggbb.
relay.config.section.player_marker.desc: The floating icons drawn on teammates in the world.
relay.config.section.pings.desc: Help alerts sent to your trusted players.
relay.config.section.map_pings.desc: Markers you and your teammates place in the world.
relay.config.section.xaero.desc: Settings for Xaero's Minimap and World Map.
relay.config.section.trust.desc: Who you share with, and who can alert you.
relay.config.hud_enabled.desc: Show the teammate list on your screen. Hidden automatically while F3 is open.
relay.config.hud_position.desc: Where the HUD sits, as a percentage across and down your screen.
relay.config.trust_empty: Nobody yet. Add a player above to start sharing.
relay.config.hud_primary_color.desc: Player names and punctuation on the HUD, as #rrggbb.
relay.config.hud_secondary_color.desc: Coordinates and dimension on the HUD, as #rrggbb.
